import networkx as nx

G = nx.Graph()
G.add_nodes_from(range(14))
for i in range(14):
    G.add_edge(i, (i+1)%14)
    G.add_edge(i, (i+2)%14)

print(nx.node_connectivity(G))
edges = list(G.edges())
edges = [(min(u, v), max(u, v)) for u, v in edges]
edges.sort()
print(edges)
